description: BRICKLAND is an adventure game where you fly a little plane over brick-built forests, rivers, and hills. Follow the wind and take your time seeing this ever-growing wilderness.
instructions: Fly the little plane with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, or tap the on-screen direction buttons. Drag the mouse to look around, scroll to zoom. Space pauses or resumes the flight, H hides or shows the interface, M toggles sound. The minimap can be enlarged to see the area around you, and returning to the starting point takes you back to where you began. The goal is simply to fly over forests, rivers, and hills — this flight has no finish line.
